chunks: ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If you lose your way, then call out: 'O Ṣāliḥ, or O Abā Ṣāliḥ, guide us to the path; may Allah have mercy upon you.'"

key_terms.أَرْشِدُونَا: guide us and direct us correctly
key_terms.الطَّرِيقِ: the road or path being sought
key_terms.ضَلَلْتَ: you became lost or strayed from the way
key_terms.يَرْحَمُكُمُ اللَّهُ: may Allah have mercy on you

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited when someone loses the road?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a specific du'a to be recited when a person has lost the way. It reflects seeking divine aid through a transmitted supplication and preserving the guidance taught by Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
